title: Reservoir
description: Reservoir is a web application designed to help users organize and track their media, connect with friends, share recommendations, and receive personalized AI-driven suggestions. Unlike existing platforms such as MyAnimeList, IMDb, and Letterboxd, Reservoir provides a more comprehensive, user-friendly experience tailored to individual preferences.
background: Developed as part of my Senior Project (CSC4999) at Florida Southern College, Reservoir was built over several hundred hours alongside teammates Aiden Redmond and Axel Beaver. My role focused on API design, database management, and feature implementation, contributing to both the technical foundation and brainstorming sessions that shaped core functionality.

title: GoalScape
description: GoalScape is a web application built with React and Express that enables users to create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) their goals while visualizing and tracking progress using a MySQL database. It features data visualization components from Flowbite and incorporates an AI wrapper from DeepSeek AI to offer personalized suggestions and strategies for accomplishing goals.
background: GoalScape was developed independently as a passion project to deepen my understanding of React, backend development, and AI integration. The project provided hands-on experience working with full-stack technologies and exploring how AI can enhance user goal management.

title: Postseason Fantasy Football
description: PostseasonFFL is a web application that lets users create and manage fantasy football teams for the NFL playoffs while enforcing league rules. It uses React, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend and Python with Supabase/PostgreSQL for backend data management. Player stats are automatically scraped from ESPN box scores and updated via scheduled GitHub Actions, ensuring teams always reflect the latest game results.
background: Postseasonffl was developed for one of my clients as a Freelance Developer. The client used to do this manually and was seeking a more efficent way to manage their leauge and this website was the culmination of that.
